hints.title: Constraint Condition
hints.text: A substring violates the condition if and only if both zero count strictly exceeds k and one count strictly exceeds k.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Contraction
hints.text: Expand the right boundary while maintaining counts. When both counts exceed k, advance the left boundary until at least one count is at most k.

hints.title: Subsegment Contribution
hints.text: Every substring ending at the right index starting between left and right is valid, contributing right - left + 1 to the total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Left and right pointers advance at most n times.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) substrings takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies sliding window counting property for substrings.
